description: Change what a visitor with no account sees and may do on a table's public page: its switches (settings), the COLUMNS a visitor is sent (hide_columns / show_columns), what the SEARCH takes (search_by, search_criteria) and the words shown when a search finds nothing. Pass only what the person asked for; the call is checked whole and a refused item changes nothing. The answer says CHANGED / UNCHANGED per item and, in plain words, what anyone with the link gets now (open_to_visitors, visitor_gets) — describe the page to the person from those two only. «A page that shows only the record searched for, without the private columns» is: settings {"allow_database": false, "allow_search": true}, hide_columns [the private fields] — or show_only_columns [the columns the person listed] when they said which ones a visitor may see — search_by [the one field people look a record up by], search_criteria ["is"]. The page's login and password are never arguments: switching password_database_boolean on makes them when the page has none, and the answer carries a link to a page that shows them to the owner once.

hide_columns.description: Fields (names or ids) a visitor must NOT be sent — «without the phone numbers and my notes»: they leave the page, a found record, one record's own page AND the page's search. Hidden from visitors only: signed in, the owner still sees them in their own table and in a record's form — say that to the person

nothing_found_text.description: The sentence a visitor reads when their search finds nothing, e.g. «No shipment found». An empty string brings the standard words back

report_id.description: A report of that table (from get_reports): change the public page of the REPORT — a second public face of the same table, with its own switches, columns and search. Leave it out for the table's own page. A column hidden on a report's page alone is NOT private: the table's own page and a record's own address send what the TABLE shows — the answer names them

search_by.description: The ONLY fields the page's search offers (names or ids): every other field and the «search every column» item are switched off. A hidden column is refused. ["all"] offers every shown column again

search_criteria.description: The ONLY criteria those fields are searched with — the search_by fields, or without search_by the fields the search offers now. ["is"] = the whole value, exactly: with it a visitor cannot list the rows (a field left with any criterion answers every row to «is not empty»). Text: is, is_not, is_empty, is_not_empty, starts_with, ends_with, like, contains, not_contains. ["all"] removes the limit

settings.description: setting: true | false — ONLY the switches that must change; a switch left out stays as it is, never send the whole list. allow_database (true = the page LISTS EVERY RECORD to anyone with the link; false = no record shows until a search finds it), allow_search (a search box; with allow_database false — a search-only page that shows what was found), add_new_record (an «add a record» button), allow_database_edits (visitors change records), allow_delete (visitors delete records), allow_database_records_clone (visitors copy a record), allow_export (export to a file), allow_pdf (save as PDF), allow_grouping, allow_pagination, hide_links (links as plain text), password_database_boolean (the page asks a login and a password)

show_columns.description: Fields (names or ids) to show to visitors again

show_only_columns.description: ALL the columns a visitor is sent (names or ids) — «the page must show only the number, the status and the date»: every other column of the table is hidden as hide_columns hides it. Not together with hide_columns / show_columns

name: update_public_page
